changelog: New: Budget-aware suggestions — `analyze --budget USD` shows total deck value, priciest cards, and flags everything over the per-card cap. Build tab gets a budget input and a live deck-value badge.
New: TCGPlayer search links on every suggestion row (set DENSA_TCGPLAYER_PARTNER env var to inject your affiliate ID).

New: Playgroup-aware analyst — `playgroup add/list/remove/set-default` stores the pod you actually play against (commanders + archetypes + power). `analyze --playgroup NAME` then tunes the executive summary against THAT table, including threat themes like graveyard hate or counterspells. Local-only data; never leaves your machine.

New: Iteration loop — `iterate propose/preview/history` and a new Iterate button on the Build tab. Surfaces concrete cut + add proposals, previews each one's structural impact (power, curve, role counts, value delta) before applying, and logs every accept/reject so you can see your iteration history across sessions.
Tests: 582 passing (up from 474). No regressions, no LLM cost on any new feature.
